svg.text: Confidential GKE Pod • Gemma 3 27B IT (vLLM PagedAttention)
Tensor-parallel L4 / H100 GPUs • ~38 ms/token ITL • 128k context window
100% in-perimeter inference — zero external API calls or weight egress
Silicon Root of Trust • AMD EPYC SEV-SNP / Intel TDX Memory Encryption
Inline AES-256 memory controller with per-VM ephemeral key inside CPU die
Plaintext exists ONLY inside CPU registers — host OS & hypervisor read ciphertext
• Tenant holds the FIPS 140-3 Level 3 Cloud HSM key ring and approves admin access via Cloud Access Approval.
• Signed Gemma 3 27B weights load from an air-gapped CMEK bucket with zero external internet pulls.
• vLLM serves Gemma 3 27B IT at ~38 ms/token inside a per-tenant VPC Service Controls perimeter.
• Envoy verifies the vTPM 2.0 PCR[0..7] quote before routing any tenant prompt or tool call.
• AMD EPYC SEV-SNP encrypts model weights, KV-cache, and prompts in DRAM so plaintext never leaves CPU registers.
• Disabling the customer CMEK halts every pod and DB connection in 41.2s (< 60s SLA).
Sovereign hardware enclave and key custody
